emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver Miners (SIL) confirm a leadership handoff from Memory/HBM: if SIL closes at a 20-day high while SMH simultaneously fails to make a new high in the same window, the handoff is confirmed and the watch retires. theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Second-ranked theme with the best structural profile in the eligible leaderboard: full breadth (1.0), high durability (0.78), non-crowded (z 0.58), and the strongest trend-health tag behind the leader. Unlike the fading headline theme, this one has breadth and cohesion still intact, which is the durability leg the tracker asks us to judge ourselves.
theses.dissent: Silver Miners are high-beta to the metal itself and a broad rotation is already underway; if the broad tape rolls over, funding-driven equity miners fall faster than the commodity, and 'full breadth' can compress in days.

falsifier.text: SIL lags GDX by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day stretch before the 30-day check date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Third-ranked theme with the strongest durability bar in the top tier (0.80), full breadth (1.0), and a clean 'trend' Hurst tag rather than 'mixed'. It is the highest-trend-health eligible non-semiconductor theme, supported by the only validated leg: trend discipline.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have already repriced a lot of the rate-cut and geopolitical premium; a dollar bounce or easing disappointment hits them hard, and the theme is a classic late-cycle crowded trade that just hasn't registered as crowded (z 0.40).

falsifier.text: GDX underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Crowded (z 1.93, the highest in the eligible set) with a trend tag and full breadth but the crowding flag is a size-down caution for anyone holding it. This is expressed as an underweight lean, not a fade or short; it reflects humility about chase risk into an attention-saturated theme.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has genuine secular demand and a high durability bar (0.86); the crowding flag has no basket-level forward edge and the trend is intact, so it may simply keep grinding higher.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 20-day high and holds it for 5 consecutive sessions before the check date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
